issues.detail: Author gate evidence_c6e1b8da.gate(generate, grid) needs the native generator and native coordinates; it cannot be dispatched as require_colour_evidence(tid, demos, [{"input": q}], palette, d4). Added slide_stack_c6e1b8da_evidence.py (pure Python, visible coordinates, no native import) with the dispatch signature; agrees with native replay on 12000 scenes.

Unfiltered native draws make the (correct) program raise about once per ~2000 pairs (6/12000 here; seed 61860021 witness). The standard audit.py seed stream happens to avoid them (~60% chance for a 1000-pair stream). Builders MUST call the gate; or host may apply the constructor proposal in notes.json (reject draws where another still-box order passes draw() with identical input and different output).

verify() solves each demo as a query, so ambiguous demos are a context shortfall: gate raises MissingColourEvidence (resample demos, keep query), distinct from IntrinsicAmbiguity on the query (drop query).
